name: pokemon-higher-or-lower
description: Chrome extension game: guess which Pokémon has the higher stat.

scripts.build:engine: emcmake cmake -S engine -B build/wasm -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build/wasm
scripts.test:engine: cmake -S engine -B build/native && cmake --build build/native --config Debug && ctest --test-dir build/native -C Debug --output-on-failure
